The rest of the sheet uses logical properties, and this was the one physical holdout that had a logical equivalent. Browsers that don't support `block` fall back to the `vertical` line. ## One edge case I left alone A heading nested two sectioning levels deep gets only 1rem of space above it instead of 2rem, for example: ```html

``` The rule at line 43 only looks at the heading's direct parent, and here that `section` is a first child.
